notes: Template for win-c-clear-skill whitelist. Copy to targets.json and edit per machine. Paths MUST use environment variables (%LOCALAPPDATA%/%APPDATA%/%USERPROFILE%/%TEMP%/%ProgramData%/%WinDir%/%ProgramFiles%/%SystemDrive%) so the skill works across PCs and users. IMPORTANT for type=glob: 'paths' is the CONTAINING DIRECTORY and 'glob' selects which files inside it are removed (root level only, subdirectories untouched). An empty or missing 'glob' on a glob target means the whole directory's contents get cleaned, so never point 'paths' at a directory you would not be willing to empty.

targets.risk: Removes ONLY root-level files matching 'glob' inside 'paths'; subdirectories and non-matching files are left alone. Drop the glob and this target would empty the entire directory instead.
